text: The human infrastructure port pins gecko_decision 5.0.0 by digest and supplies TASKCLUSTER_VOLUMES=/builds/worker/artifacts. The task is built server-side without the in-tree context/tooling, explaining its hard-coded image hash. Fixed configuration retains both values. This audit does not inspect the container contents or prove a successful decision task.
title: The decision container version and artifact volume form one task contract
